description: Everything the WebView may do. The sync core's own commands are the whole surface; no general-purpose capability is granted.

_deliberatelyAbsent.note: Issue #34 requires the WebView to have no generic filesystem, SQL, shell, HTTP, or remote executable-content capability. These plugins are not depended on at all, so the capability cannot be re-granted by editing this file alone.
plugins: fs — the core resolves every path itself; commands take identifiers
sql — durable state is reached only through typed commands
shell — nothing is executed on the user's behalf
http — the first release performs no network I/O from the WebView
updater — no automatic updater in the first release
